## Status

- Users live in `src/lib/users.ts` as an in-memory list.
- `/dashboard` shows the current user, the team, and lets the current user
  upgrade to the paid Pro plan.
- There is no sign-in and no email yet.

## Billing

Paid subscriptions run on [Stripe Checkout](https://stripe.com/payments/checkout)
(subscription mode):

- `src/app/dashboard/actions.ts` — server action that creates a Checkout
  session for the signed-in user and redirects them to Stripe.
- `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts` — webhook that flips a user's plan
  to `"pro"` once Stripe confirms payment (`checkout.session.completed`),
  and back to `"free"` if the subscription is later cancelled or goes unpaid.
- `src/lib/users.ts` — in-memory `plan` / `stripeCustomerId` fields and the
  helpers the checkout action and webhook use to read/update them.

### Local setup

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill in your Stripe **test mode**
   keys.
2. Create a Product in the Stripe dashboard with a recurring **monthly**
   Price, and set its id as `STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID`.
3. Forward webhooks to your dev server and use the printed secret as
   `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`:
   ```bash
   stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe
   ```
4. Start the app and click "Upgrade to Pro" on `/dashboard`. Pay with
   Stripe's [test card](https://docs.stripe.com/testing) `4242 4242 4242 4242`.

## Develop

```bash
npm run dev
```

Everything is staged and builds cleanly. I won't commit — I'll leave that to you unless you want me to.

## Summary

Implemented Stripe subscriptions end-to-end (chosen for its mature Checkout + webhook model and first-class Next.js support):

- **`src/lib/users.ts`** — added `plan: "free" | "pro"` and `stripeCustomerId` to `User`, plus `setUserPlan`, `upgradeUserToPro`, `downgradeUserToFree`, `setUserStripeCustomerId`, `getUserByStripeCustomerId`.
- **`src/lib/stripe.ts`** — lazy Stripe SDK client, plus helpers to read `STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID`/`NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` with clear errors if unset.
- **`src/app/dashboard/actions.ts`** — server action `startProCheckout()` that creates a subscription-mode Checkout session for the current user (`client_reference_id`/`metadata.userId` so the webhook can map back) and redirects to Stripe.
- **`src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`** — verifies the Stripe signature, then on `checkout.session.completed` stores the Stripe customer id and calls `upgradeUserToPro`; on `customer.subscription.updated`/`deleted` keeps the plan in sync with the subscription status (handles cancellations/unpaid).
- **`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — shows the current plan, an "Upgrade to Pro — $12/mo" button (posts to the server action) when not already Pro, and a success/cancelled banner from the Stripe redirect.
- **`.env.example`** — `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` (placeholders); adjusted `.gitignore` to allow committing this file despite the broad `.env*` ignore.
- **`README.md`** — documents the billing flow and local setup (`stripe listen`, test card).

Verified with `npm run build` (TypeScript + Next build both clean) and `npx eslint .` (no warnings). Since there's no real payment processor available in this environment, I couldn't do a live checkout run — worth smoke-testing with real Stripe test keys and `stripe listen` before shipping.
